feature_contract.goal: Preserve full 4:3/16:9/21:9 main-menu and car-selection sprite proportions while preventing half-published or non-finite custom-matrix sprite geometry from reaching the DX9Ex draw path during resize/reset.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Original custom-matrix four-vertex sprite geometry, UI matrix native-containment and existing menu regressions only; gameplay HUD, F11, ESC, world effects, SkyGlow, FFB, DX11 and DXVK remain unchanged.
trace_stages: Original game custom-matrix SPRARGS2 provides four transformed menu/car-selection positions and texture UVs.
Game D3DXVec4Transform and desktop/portrait containment calculate all 28 position, color, RHW and texture-stream fields before atomic publication.
Original D3D9 DrawPrimitiveUP consumes complete validated game buffer, then DX9Ex stereo per-eye and OpenXR host composition follow existing ownership.
subcomponents: Stage all four custom-matrix corners and original packed color/texture addressing into one complete fixed 28-float draw candidate.
Validate device lifetime and every vertex XYZ/UV before writing the globally shared sprite buffer; preserve valid pixel positions and all existing native-aspect multi-sprite paths.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Valid original menu/car-select matrices retain original projected pixels and texture data while complete four-corner screen geometry is published before original D3D9 DrawPrimitiveUP.
Failed texture/device state or any nonfinite corner/UV returns without corrupting the original shared vertex stream or issuing poisoned DrawPrimitiveUP; mutation coverage rejects missing checks.

Exact validation-bearing SHA passes DX9Ex Active full Win32 x86 game/x64 OpenXR host/package, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and affected-file Full Source Impact as applicable; HMD acceptance separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: At GitHub material parent, original src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp draw_sprite_custom_matrix_mid wrote four transformed vertices incrementally to global g_spriteVertexStream and then issued DrawPrimitiveUP with no complete-quad finite validation.
source_trace: Exact original custom-matrix texture-desc and D3DXMatrix transformation callback constructs four SPRARGS2 corners.
Shared g_spriteVertexStream indices 0-27 are overwritten progressively as each transformed corner is computed.
Game DrawPrimitiveUP receives the shared stream; DX9Ex screen-space stereo applies existing per-eye mapping.
diagnosis.root_cause: A malformed intermediate corner or UV after device reset could leave partial content in the original shared quad or submit nonfinite D3D9 screen geometry; existing checks covered input scale and texture descriptor but not all generated corners before publish.
alternatives_rejected: Changing OpenXR per-eye FOV mapping would not prevent a nonfinite pre-Draw game vertex stream and risks world stereo.
Rewriting already-correct multi-sprite aspect modes is unnecessary for the independent custom-matrix publish failure.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material SHA 73d9feb842ed stages four corners in std::array<float, 28>, preserves D3DCOLOR and original quad offsets, checks all XYZ/UV and device, copies into shared stream only after complete validation.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Active UI matrix regression test now asserts complete staging and four negative mutations for shared copy omission, Y/UV finite checks, and incorrect 28-float capacity.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Scope stays entirely within the original D3D9 menu producer; no changes to R30 semantic ownership, per-eye affine, headset host or stereo world matrices.

remaining: Source and static Win32/host/package gates passed at the exact SHA; main-menu/car-selection visual appearance and any white-texture symptom still NEED_HMD_TEST on Quest3/VDXR. No hardware visual PASS or backend promotion is asserted.
result_notes: The four-vertex D3D9 custom-matrix menu producer now stages/validates the entire XYZ/UV quad and device before touching the shared buffer. Three verifier corrections repaired obsolete early-write, weak mutation, and Draw owner expectations. The source change is independently material; all four required workflow groups confirmed SUCCESS.
